reason: Our ERP already has a student app and we send notices on it and on WhatsApp groups, so I don't see why I should add another app and ₹9 lakh a year to the budget. With NAAC due next year, my team has no time to onboard a new vendor or chase IT for Microsoft 365 and ERP access.
objection: This duplicates what our ERP vendor already gives us, and a small startup asking for access to student data means more paperwork for IT and legal at a time I can least afford it.
would_change_my_mind: If another college like ours showed me their missed-submission numbers going down and how that helped their NAAC report on student support, and the pilot needed nothing from my staff except IT approval.
